learning_objective: 🎯 Transform flat sheets of paper into amazing 3D artworks using folds, cuts, and tons of creativity!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Paper usually lays perfectly flat on a desk, which is 2D. But when you fold, twist, or roll it, it magically turns into a 3D object that pops up and has true shape!

main_concepts.concept_title: ✂️ The Magic of Folds and Cuts
main_concepts.simple_explanation: You do not always need glue to build things. By making precise creases and careful scissor cuts, you can create pop-up cards, animals, and flying airplanes.
Texture is how something feels. You can create bumpy, ridged, or soft textures just by crumpling, tearing, or fringing the edges of your paper.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Accordion Fan Fun
fun_activity.instructions: Take a colorful sheet of paper and fold it back and forth in straight, even lines. Pinch the bottom together and fan out the top to keep yourself cool with your new 3D craft!

quick_recap: ⭐ Paper crafts let you turn a flat 2D page into a cool 3D object.
⭐ Folding, cutting, and rolling are the key skills to creating paper art.
⭐ You can create awesome bumpy and fluffy textures by crumpling and tearing paper.
⭐ Precision matters: a sharp, clean fold makes your final craft much stronger!
